purpose: Obtain a directly attributable commercial quote sufficient for supplier-package verification and later landed-cost calculation.

targetSpecification.preferredStyle: oversized striped/turkish/cabana-style; supplier may quote nearest stock option separately
targetSpecification.branding: quote both unbranded stock option and custom private-label option if available

messageEnglish: Hello, we are evaluating an import to Romania and need a formal quotation for a retail set of 4 oversized beach towels. Required specification: 100% cotton, approximately 100 x 180 cm each towel, for beach/pool use. Please quote the closest stock product and, separately, a customized/private-label option if available. Please confirm: (1) exact material composition and GSM/weight per towel; (2) MOQ in pieces and in 4-piece retail sets; (3) EXW and FOB price per towel and per 4-piece set for MOQ, 200 sets, 500 sets and 1,000 sets where possible; (4) sample price and sample lead time; (5) production lead time; (6) retail packing options for 4 towels; (7) master carton quantity, carton dimensions and gross/net weight for the quoted 4-piece configuration; (8) FOB port and Incoterm; (9) whether you can quote DDP delivery to Bucharest, Romania, and if yes the DDP freight/total for MOQ and 200 sets; (10) HS code you normally use; (11) available product/testing/compliance documents for EU textile sales; and (12) quotation validity/date. Please identify the exact product/model or attach photos/spec sheet so the quotation can be tied to the quoted item. Thank you.
requiredResponseFields: exact quoted product/model or attributable photos/spec sheet
DDP Bucharest availability/price or explicit not offered
